extracted.name: Too Easy Peach Cobbler
extracted.description: Fresh peaches are sliced and arranged in an 8x8-inch pan and covered with strips of white bread instead of the traditional biscuit dough.
ingredient_lines: 6 fresh peaches - pitted, skinned, and sliced
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Butter an 8-inch square baking dish.
Cut crust from bread slices, and cut each into 4 or 5 strips. Spread fruit into prepared pan, and cover with a layer of bread strips.
Beat together butter, sugar, and flour; mix in egg. Pour mixture over the fruit and bread.
Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown.
